title: Relief** **to** **shareholders** **in** **respect** **of** **agricultural** **income-tax** **attributable** **to
text:
235. Relief to shareholders in respect of agricultural income-tax attributable to

dividends.—[Omitted by the Finance (No. 2) (Act, 32 of 1971), s. 28 (w.e.f. 1-4-1972). Prior to its
_omission, it was amended by the Taxation Laws (Amendment) (Act, 42 of 1970), s. 41 (w.e.f. 1-4-1971)_
_and with retrospective effect from 1-4-1962, the Finance Act, (13 of 1966), s. 27 (w.e.f. 1-4-1966) and the_
_Finance Act, 10 of 1965, s. 55 (w.e.f. 1-4-1965).]_
